title: Trending list and entity kinds filter
description:
As a reader, I want a list of trending entities by kind, so that I can see what is moving.

```gherkin
Feature: Trending list
  Scenario: Ordered by change
    Given computed trends
    Then the list orders entities by change with counts shown, excluding entities marked new

  Scenario: Filter by kind
    When a kind is chosen
    Then only entities of that kind are listed
```
